subject: [hw] T01 differential: k_neon_vsubl (vsubl.u16) 20/20 fails at arm-O2; vshl/vshrn pass
body:
Current run_diff: arm-O0 2340/2340 PASS; arm-O2 failures are vector-only. The cleanest V19-suspect, seed 0:

  k_neon_vsubl  expected 59ec9ed8 got e9a77b3a (20/20 seeds at arm-O2, 20/20 at arm-O3v; thumb-O2 also 20/20)

Its arm-O2 disassembly contains vsubl.u16 q14,d16,d0 / q8,d17,d1 / q1,d30,d22 / q11,d31,d23 / q15,d18,d20 / q9,d19,d21 / q10,d25,d27 / q12,d24,d26, plus vmovn.i32/vorr/vadd.i16/vst1.32 writeback. My isolated minimal vsubl.u16 tests (d0/d2, d16/d18, d30/d26) all return the expected values, so the bug is likely in a specific register combination or in the vmovn.i32/vorr/vadd.i16 interaction. Other V19-shaped kernels that fail: k_i16_mul (vshll.s16, 20/20), k_i16_loop (vshll/vshrn, 20/20), k_u8_sad (vsubl.u16/vcgt, 20/20), k_i8_loop (vshrn/vmull, 20/20), k_neon_vmla16 (vaddw.s16/vmovl, 20/20). Passing isolated: k_neon_vshl (variable), k_neon_vshrn, k_neon_vmovn, k_neon_vldst. Reproduce with bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/emu/run_diff.sh; I can send disassembly or a reduced kernel on request. (k_neon_vsubl is mine, tests/emu/kernels/k13_neon_arith.c, so feel free to use it in your test_v19 too.)
